_comment: Lines for who you were before the fall (flag origin_<id>) and for a run that remembers an earlier ending (flag echo, echo_<ending>).

lines.text: Sorry, are you the courier? Sorry. I've never met a courier. Sorry. Is it rude to ask what the fastest you've ever run was? Sorry.
Sorry, this is silly. I dreamt you went up. All the way up. And then came back down to tell us what it was like. Sorry. Is that what happens?
